app.name: Cyberstream
tvi.how2Wireless: Your TV only has “Wireless debugging”? Turn it on: the app will then ask for the pairing code shown by the TV.
tvi.pairText: On the TV: Developer options › Wireless debugging › “Pair device with pairing code”. Enter the 6-digit code shown, keeping that window open on the TV.
tvi.pairPortHelp: Only if the app does not find it: the TV shows “IP address & port”, the port is the number after the “:”.
tvi.err.code: Wrong code: check the 6 digits shown on the TV (a new code appears each time it is opened).
tvi.err.pairPort: The TV is not announcing pairing: keep its “pairing code” window open, or enter the port shown.
tvi.err.pairOld: Pairing with a code needs Android 12 or later on the phone.
tvi.intro: Install Cyberstream on an Android TV (Google TV, Android TV) on the same Wi-Fi, straight from this phone. First allow remote installs on the TV, once:
tvi.how1Text: On the TV: Settings › System › About (or Device Preferences › About). Press “Build” (or “Android TV OS build”) 7 times with the remote until “You are now a developer”.
tvi.how2Text: Back in Settings › System › Developer options, turn on “USB debugging” (on some TVs: “Network debugging” or “ADB debugging”). The TV and this phone must be on the same Wi-Fi.
tvi.howNote: Nothing is installed without your consent: the TV will ask to allow this phone.
tvi.pickText: Choose your TV. Only TVs with debugging on can receive the app.
tvi.scanning: Looking for TVs on the network…
tvi.none: No TV found. Check that debugging is on and the TV is on the same Wi-Fi, or enter its IP address.
tvi.manual: Or enter the TV’s IP address
tvi.manualHelp: Shown on the TV: Settings › Network & Internet › your Wi-Fi.
tvi.approve: Look at your TV: it asks “Allow debugging?”. Tick “Always allow from this computer” and choose “Allow” with the remote.
tvi.err.approve: The TV did not allow this phone in time. Try again and choose “Allow” on the TV.
tvi.err.connect: Cannot reach the TV. Check that debugging is on and both devices are on the same Wi-Fi.
tvi.err.signature: Another Cyberstream (signed differently) is already on the TV: uninstall it and try again.
tvi.err.storage: Not enough space on the TV.
tvi.err.download: Downloading the app failed. Check the phone’s Internet connection.
tvi.err.unsupported: This needs Android 8 or later on the phone.
tvi.successText: You’ll find Cyberstream in the TV’s apps.
tvi.disableText: On the TV: Settings › System › Developer options › turn off “USB debugging” (or the whole developer mode). It is no longer needed, and leaving it on lets other devices of the network ask for access to the TV.
player.connBusy: The provider refuses the connection for now (subscription in use on another device?). Retrying…
player.connBusyFatal: Your provider refuses the connection: your subscription is probably in use on another device (one connection allowed). Stop playback on the other screen and try again.
voice.prompt: Say a command: “put on BBC One”, “home”, “play the movie…”
voice.unavailable: Speech recognition is unavailable on this device
settings.liveBufferIptv: Also for my IPTV source’s channels
settings.liveBufferIptvHint: The buffer is always used for official streams (France 2, ARTE…). For your IPTV source it slows the start (about 10 s instead of 2); without it, pause keeps about 50 s.
settings.liveBufferHelp: Live TV is recorded on the device while you watch, so you can pause or go back even without provider catch-up. About 1 GB per 30 min in HD.
trakt.text: Link your Trakt account to get “For you” lists, your watchlist and your personal lists on Home (only titles available in your sources), and to record what you watch automatically. Create a free app at trakt.tv/oauth/applications (Redirect URI: urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob), then paste its Client ID and Client Secret here.
trakt.help: Keys stay on this device, in secure storage.
trakt.goTo: On your phone or computer, open {url} and enter:
trakt.expired: The code expired or was refused: try again.
trakt.badApp: Client ID or Client Secret refused by Trakt.
trakt.network: Trakt isn’t responding, try again later.
replay.error: Replay can’t be loaded right now.
replay.providerDown: {name} is unavailable right now (network or access from abroad).
replay.footer: Free, legal replay from ARTE, france.tv, LCP, Public Sénat and Okoo, read from their official services. Some videos are only available from France.
replay.unavailable: This video is no longer available.
replay.geo: Video not available from your country or network.
replay.drm: This video is protected: it only plays in the official app.
replay.officialLiveHint: France 2, 3, 4, 5, franceinfo, LCP-Public Sénat and Arte play from the channel’s free stream (better picture); your source takes over if it fails.
profiles.name: Profile name
profiles.countryHelp: Used to rank channels (the country’s most watched first).
profiles.langHelp: Movies, series and channels in these languages are suggested first.
profiles.deleteConfirm: Delete profile “{name}” and all its data?
onboard.title: Welcome to Cyberstream
onboard.subtitle: A player for your own IPTV sources. The app does not provide any content.
onboard.label: Source name
onboard.tmdbText: A free TMDB token unlocks posters, logos, synopses, cast and charts (Top 10, now playing…). It is stored encrypted on this device, in your profile.
onboard.tmdbToken: TMDB read access token (API v4) or v3 API key
onboard.tmdbHelp: Create it for free on themoviedb.org → Settings → API.
home.emptyText: Your source may only contain TV channels. Head to the Live TV tab.
error.title: Oops, this screen could not be shown
error.text: The rest of the app still works. Try again, or reload the app if it keeps happening.
age.locked: This title is not recommended under {n}: parental PIN required.
person.none: None of their films or series are in your catalogue.
settings.maxAgeHelp: Movies and series rated above this age ask for the parental PIN.
prefetch.title: Pre-download
prefetch.sub: Android downloads channels, movies, series and the TV guide while the app is closed: everything is ready when you open it.
prefetch.never: No pre-download yet (Android picks the moment).
os.text: Community subtitles from OpenSubtitles, used when a movie or episode has none in your language. Free API key.
os.keyHelp: Create a free account on opensubtitles.com, then “API consumers” → “New consumer”.
os.accountHelp: With an account: 20 downloads a day instead of 5. Downloaded subtitles are kept on the device.
os.profileSub: When the movie or episode has none in your languages
os.profileNoKey: First add an API key in Settings → Services
os.offsetHelp: Subtitles late on the voice: − 0.5 s. Early: + 0.5 s. Remembered for this video.
enroll.title: Set up the TV with your phone
enroll.step1: Scan this QR code with the phone’s camera (same Wi-Fi as the TV).
enroll.step2: Fill in the form, or tap “Open in the Cyberstream app” if it is installed on the phone.
enroll.lanOnly: Settings go straight from the phone to the TV over your local network. Nothing goes through the Internet.
enroll.noNetwork: The TV is not on a local network: the QR code can’t be shown.
enroll.withPrefs: Also apply language and country preferences
enroll.sendHelp1: On the TV, open Cyberstream then “Set up with my phone” (or Settings → Sources → From a phone).
enroll.sendHelp2: Scan the QR code with this phone’s camera.
enroll.sendHelp3: On the page that opens, tap “Open in the Cyberstream app”: this screen opens ready to send.
enroll.tvNotFound: TV not found. Check the QR screen is still open and both devices are on the same Wi-Fi.
enroll.sentText: Confirm the import on the TV.
sources.backupHelp: If the server stops answering, the app switches to a backup server automatically and keeps it.
update.availableSub: Android will ask you to confirm the installation.
update.desktopSub: Download the new installer from GitHub.
update.silentSub: It will install by itself when you leave the app.
update.permission: Allow “Install unknown apps” for Cyberstream, then tap Install again.
update.failed: The update failed. Try again later.
update.upToDate: The app is up to date.
update.channelMissing: The automatic update channel is not configured. APKs are available on GitHub.
update.checkUnavailable: Could not reach the update channel or read its response.
tv.noFav: Long-press a channel to add it to your favorites
channels.title: Channels
channels.noReplay: Replay is not available on this channel
search.placeholder: Search a movie, a series, a channel…
search.pickGone: This item is no longer available
search.voiceUnavailable: Voice search is not available on this device
detail.langUnknown: Language not specified by the source
myvideos.empty: Videos you start and your list will appear here
player.errorText: None of the sources responded. Check your connection or try again later.
player.webAudioWarn: Audio may be missing in the browser (AC3): the Android native player handles it.
settings.title: Settings
settings.parentalOn: Protect adult content with a PIN
settings.aboutText: Cyberstream is a player: it does not provide, host or promote any content. Movie and series data provided by TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
settings.tmdbMissing: No token: limited posters and charts
settings.categoriesHelp: Hide the categories you don’t need.
tvi.withConfig: Also send my profile and sources
tvi.withConfigHint: The TV opens straight on your profile, with your sources (credentials included) and preferences: nothing to type again.
tvi.p.launch: Launching the app on the TV
tvi.successConfig: Cyberstream is opening on the TV. You can follow the profile import and catalogue download on its screen.
player.launchTimeout: Playback does not start: try again or pick another version.
profiles.allLangsHint: Off: only categories in your audio languages (and multi-language ones) are downloaded, syncing is much faster.
sync.longHint: Only categories in your audio languages are downloaded. The app opens by itself as soon as everything is ready.
enroll.step3auto: That’s all: the import starts here by itself.
enroll.importAll: Import from my phone (profile and sources)
enroll.fromPhoneDone: Profile “{name}” and sources imported from the phone
tvi.err.profileExport: The profile could not be sent. Check that it has active sources with valid credentials.
tvi.err.launch: Cyberstream was installed, but the TV did not confirm that it opened. Retry, or open the app on the TV to transfer the profile by QR code.
enroll.importFailed: The received profile could not be imported. Start the transfer again on your phone.
radio.title: Radio
radio.name: Name
radio.invalid: Invalid address: it must start with http:// or https://
radio.hint: Long press a station for favourites. Favourites come first.
player.noRewind: Can't rewind this channel: the provider has no catch-up. Turn on “Also for my IPTV source's channels” in Settings › Player to be able to rewind.
